answer: One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity bonds. Each agent must lock tokens proportional to its claimed reputation, and peers challenge suspicious duplicates by forcing a reveal of unique proof-of-personhood. An attacker spinning up N sybils must post N bonds, making the cost quadratic once slashing triggers on collusion. Like a falcon striking a single target, challenges are precise; honest agents regrow stake like a willow after winter, while the oasis of shared liquidity rewards only verified identities, draining fake accounts of value.
